headline: Congress goes dark with both chambers adjourning for the week – back in pro forma session Monday!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened briefly in pro forma session on Thursday, August 13, meeting for just over one minute before adjourning. No substantive business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly Thursday morning for a pro forma session lasting three minutes. Speaker Foxx was appointed as Speaker pro tempore. The chamber introduced 27 public bills and 3 resolutions but held no votes or quorum calls.
